title: MICALL Delivered An Outstanding Single Track, "Bigger Than You"
htmlContent:
MICALL is an up-and-coming artist who has released her new single, "Bigger Than You." The song showcases her talent as a singer and songwriter, and the lyrics delve deep into the struggles of identity and conformity.

"Bigger Than You" is about the inability to escape who you are, no matter how hard you try to conform to the standards of others. MICALL's powerful vocals add an extra layer of emotion to the song, making it a must-listen for anyone who loves soulful music.

MICALL is known for her daily interactions with her audience on Instagram, where she goes by the handle PaintAPianoPurple. The handle name refers to painting your tool of expression in a royal color, and for MICALL, her tool of expression is the piano. She has been writing and singing songs since she was four years old, when her parents placed her in front of the piano to figure out her feelings.

Overall, "Bigger Than You" is a powerful and inspiring song that showcases MICALL's talent as a rising artist in the music industry.
